rooms.name: Bread Stair
rooms.description: A smell of rye climbs the stair from below. Bread is handed up one landing at a time on baking days.

rooms.name: Wick Square
rooms.description: Lanterns hang at shoulder height so neighbours can trim one another's wicks on the way home.

rooms.name: Soup Ferry
rooms.description: A boat in a kitchen doorway serves as a long soup pot. The keel is stamped with Iven's family mark.

rooms.name: Rope School
rooms.description: Children learn the way to high ground by knotting a rope model of their street.

rooms.name: First Aid Shelf
rooms.description: Dressings hang in net bags. Chalk arrows direct stretcher bearers toward the high dry landing.

rooms.name: Bell Nursery
rooms.description: Paper bells above the cots turn whenever air comes up from the pumps. One tiny bell is made of copper.

rooms.name: Bench of Names
rooms.description: Every birth adds a name under the bench. New names are smaller because the carver is running out of space.

rooms.name: Mechanic's Hearth
rooms.description: A bent bell striker hangs by the forge. Its maker has marked every tiny crack in chalk.

encounters.cue: Edda the mechanic has a bent striker in one hand. She asks who heard it.
encounters.result: Edda rang Ada’s old bell. The dam seat is splitting on every return stroke. She asks for a crew call and ferrymen before she will move the families. The master seat can drain the lake, seal the homes, or use the old return.

replies.text: Edda asks what colour milestones should be. Nothing she used to build ever needed one.
Edda has kept the bent striker. She asks for a nail to hang it beside the door of the new meeting room.
Edda wants the next two apprentices to trade shifts so neither crew can forget how the other valve works.

changes.text: The last drops dry on Edda’s anvil. A road crew has ordered its first set of hobnails.
Beyond the closed door, lake water reaches the silent forge. The families are safe on the high landing.
A second apron hangs at the forge. Someone from the surface crew has come down to learn the sleeve repair.

rooms.name: Cistern Bakery
rooms.description: The baker pipes oven heat through the cistern. Warm drinking water means tomorrow's loaves are already in.

rooms.name: Mended Roof
rooms.description: Dozens of cabin doors form one communal roof. Room numbers still show on their undersides.

rooms.name: Evacuation Wall
rooms.description: A painted route takes small feet from the nursery to high ground. Handprints stop where a stair has fallen away.

rooms.name: Ada's Window
rooms.description: A brass listening cup sits beside the speaking pipe. A mitten just like Mara’s hangs from the sill.

encounters.cue: Ada taps a mittened finger against her listening cup. She has been waiting to learn whose shift answered.
encounters.result: Ada survived the flood with the lower crew. She taught Edda the double knock; she asks you to tell Mara she still has the other mitten.

rooms.name: Laundry Falls
rooms.description: Soapy water drops through a mesh packed with roots. Clear drops land in the next household's pail.

rooms.name: High Landing
rooms.description: There is standing room for the whole ward if everyone leaves their bundles behind.

encounters.cue: Muster the families and carry the children up to the dry landing.
encounters.result: With Edda calling names and Iven’s boat crew carrying stretchers, every family reaches high ground. The empty lower homes can now be sealed.
encounters.hint: Speak with Edda and Iven, then summon both crews at the pilot bell.

encounters.cue: Edda keeps watch over the families gathered on the high landing.
encounters.result: Edda rang Ada’s old bell. The dam seat is splitting on every return stroke. She asks for a crew call and ferrymen before she will move the families. The master seat can drain the lake, seal the homes, or use the old return.

replies.text: Edda asks what colour milestones should be. Nothing she used to build ever needed one.
Edda has kept the bent striker. She asks for a nail to hang it beside the door of the new meeting room.
Edda wants the next two apprentices to trade shifts so neither crew can forget how the other valve works.

encounters.cue: Ada sits among her neighbours, listening for her sister through a length of pipe.
encounters.result: Ada survived the flood with the lower crew. She taught Edda the double knock; she asks you to tell Mara she still has the other mitten.

changes.text: Every name has a chalk mark. The lower families have reached this landing.

rooms.name: Tallow Court
rooms.description: Families have pooled the last of their candle fat to light the evacuation route.

rooms.name: Tide Crèche
rooms.description: The cradles are built on runners so two adults could drag them together.

rooms.name: Ratline Garden
rooms.description: Beans climb an old ship's ratlines. Their roots share water with the family in the room below.

rooms.name: Speaking Sill
rooms.description: The stone ledge carries speech to an identical sill at the dam. Names can be heard better than numbers.

rooms.name: Dry Dock Door
rooms.description: A sun on the inner face gives evacuated children something bright to walk toward.

rooms.name: Dam Pilgrim Steps
rooms.description: The steps were built one per family that stayed below. The newest stones are the smallest.

links.hint: These lower doors closed after the evacuation. The families live on the high landing now.
